The open beta of SpotiKit is here. SpotiKit gives Spotify a new look and new features: pick themes and extensions right inside Spotify, install them with one click and switch back anytime.

## Get started

1. Download `SpotiKit.exe` below and run it. Windows may show a SmartScreen warning because SpotiKit is new. Press **More info** and then **Run anyway**.
2. Open **Installation** and press **Install SpotiKit**. If Spotify is open, SpotiKit closes it and starts it again.
3. Open the Marketplace with the shopping bag icon next to the back and forward arrows in Spotify.

You need Windows 10 or 11 and Spotify from [spotify.com](https://www.spotify.com/download). The version from the Microsoft Store doesn't work. The [docs](https://spotikit.com/docs/installation) explain every step.

## In Spotify

- **Marketplace** with themes, extensions, custom apps and CSS snippets, right inside Spotify. One click to install, one click to remove.
- **Your own colors** for any theme. Change them live and share them with a code.
- **Setup profiles** save your theme, extensions and snippets, so you can switch looks with one click. Upload one and others can use it too.
- **Ratings and reviews**, with answers from the creators. Sign in with Discord to write one.
- **Updates you control.** Items keep their version until you press **Update**, and you see what changed first. Didn't like it? **Roll back** gets you the version you had.
- **Safe mode** starts Spotify with everything off, so you can find what's acting up.
- **Reports and moderation.** Anything harmful is taken out of the Marketplace and switched off wherever it's installed.

## In the SpotiKit app

- **Install and uninstall with one click.** The **Compatibility** page checks your PC first.
- **Backups** of Spotify before every change. Restore any of them, including the original Spotify.
- **Spotify updates** only come through once SpotiKit supports the new version, and SpotiKit is added back right after. You can also allow all updates or none.
- **SpotiKit updates itself**, also in the background while the app is closed.
- **Developer page** to build themes, extensions, apps and snippets from a template, in JavaScript or TypeScript, with live preview in Spotify and **Check** before you publish. There's also `spotikit-kit` for the command line.
- **Accent colors** for the app, including your own.

## Good to know

This is a beta, so some things may still be rough. If something breaks or looks off, tell us in the [issues](https://github.com/NMWplays/SpotiKit/issues).

`SpotiKit.exe.sha256` holds the checksum of `SpotiKit.exe`, if you want to verify your download.

SpotiKit is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Spotify AB.
